name: Shinji Gotō
want: leave the astronomy club in good hands, and maybe graduate this time
secret: He is nineteen this spring: he was held back a year after a long illness and doesn't want anyone to treat him differently.
voice: Yawns mid-sentence, long pauses, then a perfect explanation of a nebula.
description: Naps in the club room, wakes for anything to do with the sky. Has the rooftop key.
appearance: Tall and stooped, a cardigan with holes in the elbows, a telescope case on his back.
